status: AUTHORED PLANNING EXAMPLE — not the current executable production schema
title: The demo finally works
location: A practical shared work table; use the actual measured venue rather than claiming an E7 reconstruction
scene_change: Two collaborators move from quiet frustration to a shared realization when their prototype responds.
physical_assumptions: A table, two chairs and an open laptop are physically available; confirm all other props.
Three named performers are available and agree to their cues. A fourth crossing performer is optional.
Robot and light paths must be compiled and checked using the actual space and existing solver.

asset_requests.role: story information; retain existing procedural laptop when explicitly chosen if no imported match exists
idle hand business that stops when the result appears
edge foreground, not an obstacle in the robot route
optional separation from the background, remove if unavailable or distracting

beats: Looks at the screen, not the camera.
Stops a small repetitive hand action when the prototype responds.
Looks to partner only after processing the result.

cast.role: watching the lead rather than the screen at first
beats: Leans in only after the lead freezes.
Makes eye contact with the lead a beat later.

cast.role: working independently until a shared reaction becomes noticeable
beats: Continues their own task while the foreground problem develops.
Looks up after the partner reacts; does not mirror the lead gaze.

relationships: Both chairs face the work surface but are not geometrically identical copies of the lead pose.
Cup rests on the measured table surface and stays in the same place across cut coverage.
Foreground dressing stays outside the protected rig path and does not hide the key hand gesture.
Background teammate has a separate mark and eyeline target.

coverage.intent: Establish the relationship and shared space.
coverage.composition: Wide with partial foreground depth, the two leads at the action plane, teammate separated in the background.
coverage.motion: A stable shot unless a short feasible reveal improves geography.

coverage.intent: Let the audience feel the stalled attempt.
coverage.composition: An oblique two-shot, hands and screen relationship readable.
coverage.action: Lead repeats a small hand action; partner watches the lead.
coverage.motion: Hold rather than orbit around every beat.

coverage.intent: Show the evidence that changes the scene.
coverage.composition: Insert of the actual prototype/screen action; no invented AI-generated substitute.
coverage.action: Capture the real response; phone focus is manual unless proven automated.

coverage.intent: Give the realization time to land.
coverage.composition: Medium close-up reaction with the partner only partly present at the edge.
coverage.action: Lead stops moving, then shifts eyeline toward the partner.
coverage.motion: Small motivated push only if feasible; otherwise hold.

coverage.intent: Turn the private discovery into a shared moment.
coverage.composition: Two-shot with meaningful negative space into which the partner leans.
coverage.action: Partner checks the screen and reacts; background teammate notices later.
coverage.motion: A reveal or gentle reframing, not a compulsory continuous tracking move.

coverage.intent: End on the changed relationship, not a random extra object.
coverage.composition: Return to wider geography with more connected body orientations.
coverage.action: Let the shared reaction resolve before cutting.

continuity: Same cup position and laptop orientation unless the story moves them.
Coverage takes repeat action beats; a cut is not permission for physical teleportation.
validation_required: Resolve asset queries to installed IDs and hashes before generating executable scene data.
Confirm real cast/props and venue measurements.
Compile marks, camera/cart/light routes, achieved framing and currently supported nominal clearance checks.
State any missing hand contact, facial acting, focus, occlusion or collision capability.
